definition.name: One captured C component and seventeen signed lifecycle cases

steps.name: Fetch only the exact frozen native source object
Verify source and adverse fixed-product controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_thread_runtime tools.tests.test_c_thread_native_products tools.tests.test_sdk_native_products_reader tools.tests.test_c_threading_profile tools.tests.test_activation_stack_native_products tools.tests.test_activation_stack_native_source tools.tests.test_c_threading_compatibility -v

steps.name: Authenticate the original five native products without rebuilding them
Install only normal captured C compiler prerequisites
steps.run:
python3 -B tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-thread-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-thread-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
